name: Bellows Cloud Organ
description: Massive pipe organ built into a mountainside where the pipes are clouds — each cloud a different tone — and the wind plays them through bellows made of stretched sky, creating weather symphonies.
prompt: Mountainside pipe organ where pipes are actual clouds captured in transparent tubes, each cloud different density/shape producing distinct tones, massive bellows made of stretched atmospheric fabric expand/contract with wind, wind plays the organ creating visible sound waves as colored mist, storm clouds produce bass notes, cirrus wisps play high flutes, cumulus form chords, sunlight breaks through creating rainbow prisms in the music, epic scale, atmospheric physics visualized, 8k, majestic cinematic composition
caption:
The mountain sings. The clouds are its pipes. The wind, its breath. ☁️🎶

Every storm a symphony. Every breeze, a lullaby.
